summary: The diff implements the core friend system including backend data model, backend functions, React Query hooks, and UserProfilePage UI updates. All four requirements appear substantially addressed, though some details are partially visible due to truncation. The FriendRequest type uses 'recipient' instead of 'receiver' for the field name, and 'timestamp' instead of 'createdAt', which are minor deviations from the spec. The backend, hooks, and UI components are all present and wired together.

missing_requirements.reason: The implemented FriendRequest type uses 'recipient' instead of 'receiver' and 'timestamp' instead of 'createdAt', deviating from the specified field names in the acceptance criteria.
